body.matters: which difference is bridged
body.prose: Five duties are listed: translate, align goals, pool data, arbitrate conflict, and reconfigure. Each names a different kind of difference between parts that must be bridged, from syntax to intention.
body.title: What a connector does

body.matters: how much is handed to a language model
body.prose: Six components are drawn, and two of them, the orchestrator and the translator, are to be language models; the rest are a capability graph, a finder, and a workflow generator and executor that may be left out. How much of the chain is handed to a model is the real design variable.
body.title: Its anatomy, and the model at its heart

body.matters: which barrier is claimed, which assumed
body.prose: Placed against the INTEROP framework, the proposal claims the conceptual and organisational barriers and declines the technical one, which it assumes is already solved. The claim is narrowed to semantics and governance, the two layers where a fixed standard hurts most.
body.title: Where it claims to stand among the barriers

body.matters: what was already built
body.prose: An earlier framework from the same group supplies the three legs the connector stands on: AI for translation, simulation for validation, and mechanisms for adaptation. The present paper reads as that scaffold made into a holon.
body.title: The authors' earlier scaffold

body.matters: cost per added part
body.prose: The costs named are the ones that scale with membership: agreement on protocols, latency of semantic reasoning, exposure of sensitive exchanges, and the governance to hold it all. Prediction and ledgers are offered as partial answers.
body.title: What grows with the number of parts

body.matters: who directs the run
body.prose: Simulation is turned inside out: the parts being simulated are also the ones steering the run, changing its rules and objectives as it proceeds. The novelty claimed is not a model but a change in who holds the controls of the trial.
body.title: The rehearsal in which the actors direct

body.matters: which side of the run the agent stands on
body.prose: An agent may be the thing simulated, the helper of the simulator, or the monitor of the run. Holons inherit the three stances unchanged, and the paper adds a fourth word for the case where all three are held at once.
body.title: Three stances toward a simulation

body.matters: how much the actors may change the rules
body.prose: From passive to proactive, the scale measures how much the actors may alter the run: supplying data, adjusting parameters, learning across runs, rewriting the rules. The implementation notes and challenges are the price of climbing that scale.
body.title: Degrees of direction

body.matters: distance between actor and double
body.prose: In the HLA setting each holon is given a federate as its double, and the connector's own double manages the federation with an authority that stops at the simulation's edge. Errors are flagged upward, results invalidated, and the run reinitialised, so the trial has its own small nesting inside the larger one.
body.title: Doubles under a limited authority

body.matters: the gap between sketch and place
body.prose: A sparsely settled region is the single place where every proposed piece is assigned a position and a task. It is a sketch rather than a trial, and what matters in reading it is the distance between the sketch and the ground it names.
body.title: One territory where it is laid out

body.matters: what the absence reveals
body.prose: The second purpose of the platform is to locate places with no means of travel, which can only be seen as gaps in the routes the system computes. Absence is made visible by the shape of what is present.
body.title: Finding what is absent

body.matters: which role each quality is cast in
body.prose: Each of the five qualities is cast in a role: travellers are understanding parts, transport services are unbiased and effective, infrastructure is vigilant, the communication channel is unbiased, and the connector holds the highest authority. The qualities become jobs the moment they meet a place.
body.title: The casting

body.matters: the phase of the loop
body.prose: The system runs as a cycle: initialise the federation and its policies, exchange requests and conditions, adapt and optimise, validate and return. The same cycle is then replayed inside the simulation block, so one loop stands for two.
body.title: The loop of a trip

body.matters: the claim a sketch licenses
body.prose: Scalability, flexibility, fairness and lower emissions are all claimed for the territory, each by appeal to a property of the architecture rather than to an observation from the ground. The discussion licenses the claims by the drawing alone.
body.title: What the sketch is said to show

body.matters: what remains to be shown
body.prose: The closing pages say plainly that the roles are analytical constructs, the case is not a validation, and the hierarchies, evaluation methods and shared ontologies are still to be characterised. The paper ends by listing the parts of itself that are not yet held.
body.title: What is admitted unfinished

body.matters: how much direction a whole may give its parts before their autonomy is spent
body.prose: The whole is a field of wholes inside wholes, where each part keeps its own footing while a higher whole gives it a direction. The same lending of direction recurs at every depth of the held paper, from the frame down to the sentences.
body.title: A field of nested wholes

body.matters: the rate at which authority falls off as one descends the nesting
body.prose: Wholes are recursively nested, and the higher a whole sits the more it may decide, while lower wholes execute within their local latitude. The paper contrasts this pyramid with a looser distribution of authority, and the contrast is a claim about where decisions live.
body.title: Depth and falling authority

body.matters: which capability a holon is for, rather than what it is made of
body.prose: The added dimensions are less kinds of thing than roles a holon can take on, each answering a lack the authors find in autonomous systems. Ethics, effectiveness, understanding, freedom from bias and vigilance are set beside one another and cross-wired into a recursive whole.
body.title: Five capacities a holon wears

body.matters: the time horizon and range of consequence that count in a decision
body.prose: An effective holon is distinguished from an efficient one by the breadth and length of the consequences it weighs, including environment, society and long-run performance. Efficiency optimises a short window; effectiveness widens it.
body.title: Effective holon and the horizon of consequence

body.matters: whether ethics is a hard constraint or merely one weight among others
body.prose: The ethical holon is pictured as operating within encoded guidelines, so that moral limits are evaluated alongside operational goals instead of being traded against them. Safety, legality and harm-minimisation are the named anchors, with vehicles and healthcare as examples.
body.title: Ethical holon as bounded constraint

body.matters: the richness of representation held against the effort of keeping it current
body.prose: An understanding holon is a holon whose strength lies in holding structured knowledge, through ontologies and semantic inference, so that heterogeneous data becomes situational meaning. Its pull is toward richer representation and the cost that comes with it.
body.title: Understanding holon and carried meaning

body.matters: where bias enters the loop and whether it is checked there continuously
body.prose: Bias is treated as a recurring pattern that can be catalogued, constrained and audited inside the decision loop, rather than as a one-off defect. The unbiased holon is the place where such checks and fairness constraints live.
body.title: Unbiased holon and bias as a watched pattern

body.matters: whether awareness is pooled across levels or stays local to each holon
body.prose: Vigilance is the shared awareness that lets local holons stay aligned with the whole, through distributed sensing and cross-level dissemination. Without it, parts are informed locally yet misaligned globally.
body.title: Vigilant holon and shared awareness

body.matters: how much shared meaning must exist in advance before two wholes can speak
body.prose: Wholes built by different hands must still meet, and the paper holds that they meet by runtime mediation rather than a shared model or fixed standard. Binding is negotiated when needed, with a mediating holon carrying the meaning across.
body.title: Federated binding across heterogeneous wholes

body.matters: how far the binding holon acts on others versus only mediating between them
body.prose: A single holon is proposed to hold the binding role: it translates, aligns goals, arbitrates among partial conflicts and reconfigures workflows, while leaving the internal logic of other holons alone. It sits above the rest as the place where federation is coordinated.
body.title: The federated interoperability holon

body.matters: which functions are kept, and whether connection or only execution is controlled
body.prose: The binding holon is decomposed into an orchestrator, an integrator that records what each element can do, a translator, a finder, and generators and executors of workflows. Some of these can be left out, leaving the holon with control over execution alone and not over connection.
body.title: Parts inside the binding holon

body.matters: the lifetime of a shared meaning, from a single exchange to a standing vocabulary
body.prose: Meaning is made disposable: an ontology is built for a single exchange, phase or episode, used, and then discarded or revised. Version tracking and mapping rules keep successive short-lived states coherent with one another.
body.title: Short-lived ontologies as temporary contracts

body.matters: which barrier sits where, and which of the three alignment approaches is chosen
body.prose: Interoperability is broken into barriers of concept, organisation and technology, and into integrated, unified and federated approaches. The paper places its own contribution on the conceptual and organisational side, treating technical links as an assumed layer.
body.title: Barriers and the three ways to align

body.matters: the gap between what present systems fail at and what a holonic frame promises to close
body.prose: The motive is a set of stubborn limits in current autonomous systems: brittle adaptation, bias, weak accountability and thin shared awareness. The authors read digital twins and learned models as an opening, and holonic structure as the frame that could hold them.
body.title: Why the holon idea is pressed now

body.matters: whether the simulated entities are also the ones directing the run
body.prose: The simulation is not only a stage on which holons act; the holons also set and adjust how the simulation runs. The paper sorts this into degrees, from holons that only feed data to ones that rewrite the rules.
body.title: Simulation whose entities also steer

body.matters: the degree to which holons decide the simulation's execution rather than just take part
body.prose: Holon-directed simulation is ordered along a line from passive data sources through reactive and adaptive holons to proactive ones that change objectives. The ordering is offered as a typology of how much a holon may decide about the simulation's own execution.
body.title: Degrees of holon direction

body.matters: whether the rehearsal mirrors live operation closely enough to be trusted
body.prose: The architecture is rehearsed inside a High Level Architecture federation, where federates stand in for holons and a federation manager reports discrepancies back up. The simulation is meant to test the system and to feed its strategies forward over repeated runs.
body.title: The HLA federation as rehearsal

body.matters: the sparse, dispersed demand that the architecture must fit
body.prose: A dispersed countryside with thin transport serves as the single worked setting, where the holonic architecture is asked to find transit deserts and coordinate scattered services. It shows the frame applied rather than proven.
body.title: A rural mobility whole held as the test case

body.matters: the ordering of request, response, monitoring and validation within each pass
body.prose: The mobility system is run as a repeating cycle in which traveller requests meet routing and pricing responses, infrastructure monitoring feeds in, a communication holon translates across organisations, and routes are validated before they return to the user. Metadata about services accumulates in a graph that speeds later lookups.
body.title: The mobility loop from request to route

body.matters: the distance between asserted benefit and demonstrated result
body.prose: Several claims outrun evidence: the value of the dimensions is argued rather than measured, the mobility case is not a validation study, and many implementation hurdles are named but not met. The held space carries these as open edges beside the proposals.
body.title: What the paper leaves unproven

body.matters: whether the asserted gains are tied to indicators that have actually been read
body.prose: The discussion reads the framework as scalable, flexible, equitable and environmentally kinder, and reaches these as properties of the design rather than as measured outcomes. The metrics named for evaluation are travel time, emissions and service access, not yet reported.
body.title: Claimed gains in fairness, scale and emissions

body.matters: how much freedom the parts keep against how much unity the whole gets
body.prose: The paper keeps asking how many autonomous parts can behave as one whole when nobody holds the whole. Its answers are specialised roles, meaning negotiated at runtime, and simulation that both mirrors and steers the system, tried on one rural case.
body.title: Coherence without a centre

body.matters: the direction authority flows between levels
body.prose: What a holon is and where the idea came from: a thing that is whole and part at once, stacked in levels, carried from factories out into other infrastructure.
body.title: The nested part-whole ground

body.matters: where authority sits relative to autonomy
body.prose: Holons sit in a holarchy, free locally and bound upward, unlike flat agents and unlike rigid hierarchies. Humans and orchestrators can take places in it.
body.title: Nested autonomy

body.matters: how far the idea travels beyond its first domain
body.prose: The idea passes from Koestler to manufacturing, then to grids, construction and cyber-physical settings, each time as a way to manage complexity.
body.title: A lineage widening outward

body.matters: what is already held versus what is missing
body.prose: Earlier work on holon frameworks, awareness and understanding dictionaries is cited, with a gap left in large-scale cross-system cooperation, and a map of what follows.
body.title: Prior pieces the paper builds on

body.matters: which lack is named, and whether a remedy answers it
body.prose: Autonomous systems are taken to fall short in four ways, and pairing holons with AI and twins is offered as the remedy.
body.title: The felt shortfalls and the promise of union

body.matters: the kind of harm a lack lets through
body.prose: Rigid adaptation, embedded bias, thin ethical reasoning and shallow situational awareness, each stated as a risk to people and to trust.
body.title: Four named lacks

body.matters: how well the two supply what the other lacks
body.prose: Twins and AI supply live data, learning and resilience, and holons supply distributed responsibility, so each covers the other's weak side. Ethical safeguards matter more where authority is spread out.
body.title: Why holons, AI and twins fit

body.matters: whether each role closes a distinct gap
body.prose: Five capacities are drawn out as kinds of holon, and each is described by the gap it answers, how it could be built, where it applies and what makes it hard. They check and feed one another and a watching layer ties them together.
body.title: A family of complementary roles

body.matters: how a norm becomes something checkable
body.prose: Ethical and unbiased holons hold judgement over right and wrong and over fairness, using ontologies of norms and of bias patterns plus audits.
body.title: Roles that hold values

body.matters: the horizon a decision is made across
body.prose: Effective holons look past quick efficiency to long-term consequence, and understanding holons turn varied data into situational meaning through ontologies and reasoning.
body.title: Roles that hold capability

body.matters: how far awareness is shared across the whole
body.prose: Vigilant holons spread awareness across levels so that locally informed parts do not drift apart globally.
body.title: The role of shared watching

body.matters: who supplies whom
body.prose: Value holons pass verdicts to the effective ones, understanding feeds both, and vigilance runs through all layers, so autonomy and collective aims hold together.
body.title: How the roles lean on each other

body.matters: claim strength versus concreteness
body.prose: Each role is introduced as a response to a stated gap, and the paper treats them as analytic constructs rather than finished implementations.
body.title: The shared frame of the roles

body.matters: whether differences are removed or bridged
body.prose: Because holons differ in vocabulary, model and owner, they need a way to interoperate that leaves their autonomy intact. The paper's answer is a particular holon built for the job.
body.title: Meaning crossing boundaries

body.matters: what each approach costs in independence
body.prose: Interoperability is a requirement; it is classed by barrier, concern and approach, and the federated approach alone leaves each party its own structure.
body.title: Why union by federation

body.matters: how long a shared meaning has to last
body.prose: On-the-fly alignment lets a newcomer be understood without prior agreement, through temporary ontologies that are made, used and dropped.
body.title: Agreement made at the moment of need

body.matters: how much the mediator may reshape connections
body.prose: The Federated Interoperability Holon sits above the roles, brokering translation, goals, data and conflicts, and is built of six components (orchestrator, integrator, translator, finder, generator, executor), with the last two optional.
body.title: The mediating holon and its parts

body.matters: which role answers which duty
body.prose: The mediator needs unbiased holons for retrieval, ethical checks on outputs, and vigilant holons as orchestrators, so the earlier roles become its subparts.
body.title: How the mediator draws on the roles

body.matters: scope claimed versus scope left to others
body.prose: Examples in cities and supply chains, the limits of standards, scale and security, and a statement that the work targets meaning and organisation, with technical layers assumed.
body.title: Where it applies and what limits it

body.matters: how far the holons control the run
body.prose: The paper stretches agent-directed simulation into holon-directed simulation, where holons act in a run and also steer it.
body.title: Simulation that directs

body.matters: what holons add to the agent case
body.prose: Three agent-and-simulation pairings, with emergence examples, give the base, and holons add levels and organisational awareness.
body.title: Lineage from agent-directed simulation

body.matters: degree of influence over the run
body.prose: A ladder from passive source through reactive and adaptive to proactive, graded by the autonomy of the holons.
body.title: Kinds of holon-directed simulation

body.matters: what the idea costs to run
body.prose: It needs real-time adaptation, coordination, and federation, and it faces cost, standards and integration with learning and twins.
body.title: What it asks for

body.matters: whether the case exercises the whole framework
body.prose: Rural mobility serves as the case: a sparse setting that needs coordination of many services and finds places with no transport.
body.title: One concrete place

body.matters: what the setting demands
body.prose: Low density and cost make centralised transport fail, and the platform must gather data, coordinate providers, locate deserts, adapt and validate by simulation.
body.title: The problem and its asks

body.matters: which holon plays which part
body.prose: Each role gets a job in the transport flow, from travellers to infrastructure monitors, under the mediating holon at the top.
body.title: Roles placed in the scene

body.matters: how test and real system stay linked
body.prose: Under the HLA, holons run as federates with a limited manager that serves as both authority in the run and part of the real system. Errors are flagged upward and a closing analysis feeds back.
body.title: The same holons as federates

body.matters: how much the case supports versus how much remains to test
body.prose: It is said to show scalability, flexibility, fairness and lower emissions, while being only an illustration, with validation and other domains left for later.
body.title: What the case is said to show

body.matters: how long a tie is allowed to last
body.prose: The whole the paper draws is an order whose parts persist while the ties between them do not: meanings, goals, workflows and federations are made at the moment they are needed and released once the need has passed. Every section returns to this one move, replacing a structure that must exist beforehand with one that arises and recedes.
body.title: Binding made for the occasion

body.matters: where authority stops
body.prose: A pyramid is drawn with the greatest authority at its top, and in the same breath that authority is reduced to the right to synchronise and restructure, never to command an interior. The highest holon in the paper is also the one most insistently said not to replace anyone.
body.title: Authority that does not own

body.matters: degree of autonomy
body.prose: The holarchy is introduced as a pyramid in which lower levels execute directives from above, and is immediately re-described as a distribution of responsibility that preserves local autonomy. Later the holons are allowed to be not fully autonomous at all, their degree of freedom set by position and objective.
body.title: The pyramid and its softening

body.matters: coordination without control
body.prose: The interoperability holon oversees, binds, arbitrates, aligns goals and restructures workflows, and holds what the case study calls the highest authority. It is at the same time declared a supra-holonic mechanism that enforces no uniform behaviour and never reaches into another holon's logic.
body.title: The coordinator above the holons

body.matters: how far the coordinator may reach into connectivity
body.prose: New elements are entered as nodes in a capability graph, found there on request, linked into a workflow blueprint and executed. The last two links may be removed, leaving a coordinator that controls execution but cannot change who is connected to whom.
body.title: The component chain and its detachable tail

body.matters: the scale at which authority is read
body.prose: Inside the coordinator its orchestrator is a superholon to the coordinator's own parts; inside the simulation a federate twin of the coordinator holds authority limited to the simulation while remaining its subholon. The same shape of authority repeats at each scale, and the simulated holon is both the actor and the thing acted on.
body.title: Authority mirrored at smaller scales

body.matters: design time against runtime
body.prose: Shared standards, common meta-models and comprehensive ontologies are set aside in favour of agreements struck between two holons at the moment they meet. What is fixed is moved from design time to the encounter itself.
body.title: Meaning settled at runtime

body.matters: how much must be shared beforehand
body.prose: Interoperation can be had by everyone adopting one format, by everyone mapping to one shared layer, or by translating between pairs with nothing shared at all. The third is kept because the first two impose a global constraint that forbids a part from evolving on its own.
body.title: Three ways to interoperate, one kept

body.matters: the lifetime of a shared meaning
body.prose: A shared vocabulary is made for a task phase, an episode or a single exchange, used, and then discarded or updated, with versioning letting several states coexist. Semantic coherence is kept without a repository that must be maintained for all time.
body.title: Short-lived ontologies as temporary contracts

body.matters: which capacity of the model is drawn on
body.prose: Among the abstract components, two are given a concrete body: a large language model fills the orchestrator for its reasoning and the translator for its adaptability to new inputs. The same kind of model is drawn on twice for different capacities.
body.title: The one technology given a name

body.matters: what a name is attached to
body.prose: Five named capabilities are first qualities a decision ought to have, then become components inside the coordinator, then become travellers, buses and roads in a mobility scene. The name survives each descent; what it is attached to does not.
body.title: Names that change body with scale

body.matters: which failure each capability answers
body.prose: A list of what current autonomous systems lack is answered by a list of holon types, each type named for the lack it addresses. The pairing is nearly one to one, with efficiency-only thinking added as a lack of its own.
body.title: Failures answered one by one

body.matters: what counts as wrong
body.prose: Ethical and unbiased holons are both built on an ontology of what is wrong, one of harms and rules, the other of known bias patterns, and both pass their verdicts forward to whoever balances. Defining the wrong is named as the hardest part of each.
body.title: The checking pair

body.matters: length of the horizon
body.prose: An efficient holon reaches its goal with least resource; an effective one lengthens the horizon to take in consequence, society and sustainability, and is harder to measure for exactly that reason.
body.title: Effective against efficient

body.matters: whether knowing is local or shared
body.prose: Understanding holons build situational knowledge from heterogeneous data inside themselves; vigilant holons distribute awareness across levels so that locally informed parts stay globally aligned. One is the interior of knowing, the other its circulation.
body.title: Knowing within and knowing across

body.matters: what function a capability performs for the coordinator
body.prose: Inside the coordinator the unbiased holon becomes a dictionary that keeps retrieval accurate, the ethical holon a validation layer or a guard against leaks, the vigilant holon the orchestrator itself, and the effective and efficient ones subsystems that need a cue to know when to act.
body.title: The five re-cast as components

body.matters: who in the scene carries which capability
body.prose: In the mobility case the capabilities become people and things: travellers are understanding holons, transport services are unbiased and effective ones, roads and weather are vigilant, the channel to outside organisations is unbiased, and ethical and unbiased holons set policy before anything moves.
body.title: The five as actors in a scene

body.matters: where there is nothing to coordinate
body.prose: Rural mobility is the single setting worked through: dispersed and unpredictable demand, services too costly to run on a timetable, and a second aim beside routing, which is to find the places where there is no transport at all to coordinate.
body.title: The one scene held still

body.matters: direction of flow between capabilities
body.prose: The checks feed the balancer, the interpreter feeds both, and the watcher spans every layer; in the emergency scenes each domain is handed to one capability. The relations are drawn as flows between named roles rather than as a hierarchy.
body.title: The five among themselves

body.matters: what happens when something breaks
body.prose: Nearly every illustration opens with something breaking: an incident, an earthquake, a pandemic, a geopolitical shock, a route that fails validation. The system is defined less by what it does when things go well than by what it rearranges without stopping when they do not.
body.title: A system known by its interruptions

body.matters: continuity through change
body.prose: Holons may be added, removed or modified, workflows regenerated and roles reassigned while the system keeps running; a disruption is met by reconfiguration rather than by reprogramming. How far the coordinator may reach into connectivity is itself left adjustable.
body.title: Rearranging without restarting

body.matters: what a discrepancy does
body.prose: The simulation replaces the users' calls and tests the platform's answers, with each holon replicated as a federate joined to its live counterpart. A discrepancy anywhere is flagged upward, invalidates the result and may send the whole federation back to its beginning.
body.title: The simulation as rehearsal

body.matters: how much the actor steers its own stage
body.prose: Holons in a simulation may only report, may respond, may learn from past runs, or may rewrite the rules and objectives of the run itself. The ladder measures how much the simulated thing is allowed to steer its own stage.
body.title: Four grades of steering

body.matters: which scene is used to show a capability
body.prose: Smart cities, healthcare, supply chains, disaster response and autonomous vehicles return in every section as the backdrop against which a capability is shown. The entrance is almost always an emergency.
body.title: The same few stages

body.matters: what is inherited and what is new
body.prose: The paper's novelties are produced by putting one word where another stood, by extending a lineage one step, and by drawing a careful line around what is not being claimed. Reading it means seeing which of its parts are inherited, which are moved, and where the moving shows.
body.title: New things made by substitution

body.matters: how far back the idea reaches
body.prose: The idea runs from Koestler's nested wholes through manufacturing systems of the 1990s to grids, construction sites and cyber-physical plants, and the authors' own earlier work on understanding and on federated interoperability is folded in as the most recent step.
body.title: A lineage carried forward

body.matters: what the substitution adds
body.prose: Agent-directed simulation has three kinds; because holons are taken to be a special class of agent, holon-directed simulation is given the same three by inference, and the term is claimed as used formally for the first time. What the substitution adds is organisational awareness and coordination across levels.
body.title: Holon put where agent stood

body.matters: the line between claimed and deferred
body.prose: Technical interoperability is assumed rather than contributed, two components of the coordinator may be dropped, the case study is said not to be a validation, and empirical testing is named as absent. Standardisation, scale, security and governance are listed as challenges and left for others.
body.title: What is set outside the claim

body.matters: where the seams lie
body.prose: The examples under effective holons are those under ethical holons word for word; the organisational and technology barriers carry each other's definitions; a sentence in Sect. 3 breaks off and resumes in Sect. 3.2; empty bullets stand in the coordinator's architecture. The text keeps the marks of having been put together from parts.
body.title: Where the assembly shows

body.matters: what the holon draws in from outside
body.prose: Digital twins supply live data and virtual counterparts, AI supplies prediction and learning, federated learning supplies adaptation without pooling data; these are the motives offered for extending the holon at all, and the integration with them is also listed as still to be explored.
body.title: What the holon draws in from outside

body.matters: where coherence is held
body.prose: Underneath the proposal is one recurring problem: how parts that keep their own logic can still act as one. The paper answers it by relocating where coherence lives, sometimes up in a coordinator, sometimes in meaning agreed for a moment, sometimes in qualities installed as parts, sometimes in a rehearsal of the system by itself.
body.title: A whole that keeps moving its center

body.matters: who may decide for whom
body.prose: Authority is first placed by rank in a nested pyramid, then said to be spread across levels, then gathered again into a coordinating holon that is called the highest authority yet denied central control.
body.title: The address of authority

body.matters: position in the nesting
body.prose: The starting picture: each holon a whole to what it contains and a part to what contains it, its freedom bounded by its position.
body.title: Nesting as the given order

body.matters: binding without owning
body.prose: The interoperability holon binds every other holon toward an objective and sits atop the use case, while the text insists it leaves each holon's inner logic untouched and replaces no one.
body.title: A center that disclaims being one

body.matters: the route from request to linked elements
body.prose: Coordination is made concrete as six parts: one that decides, one that records every element in a graph of possible links, one that translates, one that finds, one that designs a workflow, one that runs it.
body.title: The machinery of joining

body.matters: what the deciding part rests on
body.prose: Both the deciding part and the translating part are given to a large language model, for its reasoning and its adaptability to new inputs.
body.title: A language model at the core

body.matters: how much is handed over
body.prose: Autonomy is never all or nothing: holons range from mere data sources to rule-changers, and stakeholders may remove the coordinator's power to reshape connections, leaving it only to run what exists.
body.title: Autonomy as a dial

body.matters: how long an agreement on meaning lasts
body.prose: Parts that speak differently are joined not by one shared language but by translations negotiated at the moment of meeting, though lasting shared vocabularies and standards keep returning.
body.title: Meaning agreed per encounter

body.matters: how much sameness is demanded
body.prose: One format for all, a common layer above all, or pairwise transformation with neither; the third is chosen because the first two press every participant into the same shape.
body.title: Three ways to share meaning

body.matters: the lifespan of a vocabulary
body.prose: Temporary ontologies are built for one task or episode, used, then dropped or revised, so that a newcomer can be understood without prior agreement.
body.title: Vocabularies made to be discarded

body.matters: what must not be renegotiated
body.prose: Ethics, bias and understanding are to be encoded in comprehensive, stable ontologies, and future work asks for shared ones, standing against the transient meaning used between holons.
body.title: The counter-current of lasting ontologies

body.matters: whether a name stays bound to what it names
body.prose: In the reading itself, labels and what they denote sometimes come apart: barrier categories carry each other's descriptions, and one dimension's examples repeat another's word for word.
body.title: Names loosening from their content

body.matters: what the federation still presupposes
body.prose: Though meaning is to be negotiated without uniform standards, standardized protocols, shared formats, security and scale reappear as conditions the federation still depends on.
body.title: The standard that keeps returning

body.matters: which capacity is made a part
body.prose: Capacities one would expect of a whole system, such as conscience, foresight, comprehension, fairness and watchfulness, are each given their own holon, so a virtue becomes a component that can be placed, wired and checked.
body.title: Qualities turned into parts

body.matters: the deficit being answered
body.prose: Every quality is introduced as the answer to a named deficit of current autonomous systems.
body.title: Each lack summons an organ

body.matters: what each quality guards against
body.prose: The five qualities, each stated by what goes wrong without it.
body.title: Five organs

body.matters: the flow of checks between qualities
body.prose: The qualities feed and check one another: judgments of right and fairness pass to the one weighing the long term, comprehension informs them, and watchfulness spans all layers; where they conflict, a higher negotiation is called.
body.title: Qualities watching qualities

body.matters: how qualities combine in one role
body.prose: In the coordinator and in the mobility case, roles are composites: a traveller holon is an understanding one, a transport holon both fair and effective, orchestrators are called watchful by definition.
body.title: One holon wearing several qualities
